Ioannis Vrfini medici & poetæ Profopopœia animalium aliquot, elegiacis versibus descripta, impressa Viennæ in Gallia 1541. cum scholijs Iacobi Oliuarij. Elegię de pefte, & ea medicinę parte quæ in victus ratione consistit, ibidem impressæ, 1541. Feruntur præterea extare impressa huius authoris, Comentaria in Catonis libellum: Etho-logus elegans de moribus: Carmina quædam de re medica, & alia plura. Sunt autem quædam ex cufa Lugduni apud Paganum.

* Ioannis Vrfi liber de mutuo, & cenfibus annu-is, & quia ratione Chriftianus fe gerere debeat in hac caufa 1569. Germanice. Eiufdem declaraio de potestate Cæsaris in ferendis legibus de annuis redditibus, & de accipiendis illis: & quod in hac re fit difcrimen regni Christi & regni Cæsaris. Goerlicij, anno Dom. 1570. page.notes: Gutter numbers 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 and 60 on the left page were placed at approximate positions in the left column. Doubtful readings: "D.1340" (the date may be 1540); "Trilla" (could be another name); "1541" and "Oliuarij" in the Vrfini entry; "Iacobi" may be Jacobi; "Vuaynflete" may read differently. Several words are cut at a line end and are joined with their printed hyphen (for example "Hie-ronymo", "Con-ciones", "inq-quisitoribus"). The right page's first word "cum" continues a sentence from the foot of the left page. The left page number is not printed.
